name: Kano Hijiri
source:
A first-year student and a heroine in the PSV version who hates hard work as she is a natural-born genius. She claims to be [url=/c16389]Tsukuyo[/url]'s fatal rival.

Her favorite artistic fields are drawing and painting.

[spoiler]Hijiri enters high school during the game, after the former third years ([url=/c16391]Madoka[/url] and [url=/c16396]Youta[/url]) have graduated. At the end of the game, she passes her first year and moves in second year.

Barely entered the first year, Hijiri has challenged Tsukuyo for the first place of the great art exhibition of the school, putting Tsukuyo in a funny panic state because she doesn't like confrontation. She is a real fan of Tsukuyo's work and dreams that one day she will be able to surpass her.

She also gives drawing lessons to [url=/c16393]Makoto[/url] so that he can improve. She's also one of the few rare students to serve as a model for nude drawings without being embarrassed. Thus, she stripped herself in front of Makoto to be draw, even forcing him to touch her chest and butt so that he could understand the feel and texture of the material he has to draw.

Later, Hijiri become the first friend that [url=/c16392]Arisa[/url] made by her own.[/spoiler]

Hijiri is mentioned in Ai Kiss as one of the famous students of the school after she has graduated
